original_annotation_policy: Preserve original complete-string annotations and unread-at-batch-time declarations byte-identically; this is a separate later publication-status overlay.

records.read_depth: Complete original JATS/XML notice, including five body paragraphs, metadata and single linked reference, read without tool truncation; no figures or corrected result tables occur.
records.reason: Publisher investigation found systematic manipulation of publication and peer-review process; publisher disclaims confidence in article reliability/integrity and says the notice alerts readers to compromised peer review.
records.scope: The whole article is retracted; no replacement text, figures or numerical results are provided.
records.author_response_or_awareness: Corresponding author was offered agreement/disagreement; notice says any response was recorded but does not disclose the response or establish authorship responsibility.
records.evidence_disposition: Original FAM83A/breast-cancer bioinformatics claims cannot serve as reliable affirmative evidence for a drug or BUB1B mechanism. Existing retracted-publication warning is confirmed; this does not establish that a particular original numerical result was independently disproved.

records.reason: The publisher/editor retracted the article because peer review was manipulated or compromised. Their investigation indicated that a third party supplied fabricated potential-reviewer details across manuscripts; the article scientific integrity could not be guaranteed.
records.scope: Retraction of the entire original article, not an isolated numerical or wording correction.
records.author_response_or_awareness: The notice explicitly leaves unresolved whether these authors knew of third-party attempts to manipulate their manuscript review. It does not establish author awareness or specific data fabrication.
records.evidence_disposition: Preserve the original reading/identity record and retraction flag; do not rely on its network or therapy assertions as validated scientific support.

limits: The notices determine publication status and stated reasons, not independent replication or disproof of every original numerical claim. Reading two notices adds zero original-abstract coverage and no qualified compound.
